Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 5
Reason for Mistake: Presented an incorrect search result implying the Mississippi River meets the Ohio River at St. Louis, conflating the Mississippi–Missouri confluence with the Mississippi–Ohio confluence. This misinterpretation of search content, without verification from authoritative sources, could directly lead to the wrong location instead of the correct confluence at Cairo, Illinois.
